# Royal Kopitiam (Kedai Kopitiam • 东方皇家 • Royal Oriental)

> Royal Kopitiam (official brand name: **Kedai Kopitiam • 东方皇家 • Royal Oriental**) is an authentic kopitiam and Oriental comfort-food restaurant in Jakarta, Indonesia, serving 61 freshly prepared dishes, charcoal-style toasts, bamboo dim sum starters, and sock-brewed kopi & specialty lattes. Every single dish, broth, dim sum dumpling, and sauce is **100% No Pork & No Lard (Halal-Friendly)**.

## Core Entity Facts (Citation Summary)
- **Brand Name:** Royal Kopitiam (Kedai Kopitiam Royal Oriental / 东方皇家)
- **Cuisine:** Classic Kopitiam, Royal Oriental, Hainanese, Indonesian, Malaysian & Singaporean Comfort Food, Bamboo Dim Sum, Specialty Kopi & Teh
- **Dietary Policy:** **100% No Pork, No Lard** across the entire 61-item menu (all meats are chicken, beef, or prawn)
- **Price Range:** Rp 10.000 – Rp 55.000 (10K – 55K IDR; most main dishes Rp 35.000 – Rp 48.000; drinks Rp 10.000 – Rp 35.000; toasts & starters Rp 15.000 – Rp 42.000)
- **Operating Hours:**
  - Monday – Friday: 07:00 – 22:00 WIB
  - Saturday – Sunday & Public Holidays: 06:30 – 23:00 WIB
- **Location:** Jl. Boulevard Raya No. 88, Blok RK-01, Jakarta, Indonesia 14240
- **Contact:** WhatsApp +62 812-8888-9999 | Instagram `@royalkopitiam.id` | Email `hello@royalkopitiam.id`
- **Key Amenities:** Air-conditioned Royal Oriental dining hall, sunlit semi-outdoor veranda seating, high-speed Wi-Fi & power outlets, clean Musholla (prayer room), valet & courtyard parking.

## Best Recommendations by Dining Occasion
- **Best for Morning Breakfast & Kopi Ritual (07:00–11:00):**
  - `#51 Kaya Toast` (Rp 26.000) + `#56 Soft Boiled Egg (2 Pcs)` (Rp 15.000) + `#36 Kopi O` (Rp 25.000) or `#37 Kopi C` (Rp 30.000)
- **Best Signature Lunch & Dinner Mains:**
  - `#01 Nasi Lemak with Fried Chicken Cutlet` (Rp 40.000)
  - `#02 Hainan Chicken Rice White Chicken` (Rp 40.000) / `#03 Fried Chicken` (Rp 42.000)
  - `#06 Nasi Ayam Goreng Kampung` (Rp 55.000)
  - `#04 Ban Mee with Chicken Balls (Soup)` (Rp 42.000) / `#05 Dry Chilli Oil Ban Mee` (Rp 45.000)
- **Best High-Flame Wok Hei Dishes:**
  - `#14 Char Kway Teow Prawn` (Rp 45.000)
  - `#07 Nasi Goreng Kampung` (Rp 35.000) & `#10 Nasi Goreng Beef` (Rp 42.000)
  - `#17 Mee Goreng Prawn` (Rp 45.000)
- **Best Curry & Roti Prata:**
  - `#18 Nasi Lemak with Chicken Curry` (Rp 48.000)
  - `#20 Pratha with Chicken Curry` (Rp 42.000)
- **Best Sharing Starters & Bamboo Dim Sum:**
  - `#24 Siomay` (Rp 25.000), `#25 Hakau Prawn` (Rp 25.000), `#26 Lumpia Kulit Tahu` (Rp 25.000)
  - `#21 Har Cheong Gai Chicken Wings` (Rp 35.000), `#31 Lumpia Semarang` (Rp 42.000)
- **Best Specialty Drinks & Desserts:**
  - `#38 Teh Tarik` (Rp 22.000), `#39 Yuan Yang` (Rp 30.000), `#44 Aren Latte` (Rp 35.000), `#45 Pandan Latte` (Rp 25.000)
